Oct 17 submission: the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. Anything that ships in the build has to be merged by then. Submit Fri Oct 17.
iOS screenshots can only change with a new version, so new iOS screenshots go up with the Oct 17 submission and are due by the same Oct 16 12:00 PT cut.
Apple review has been taking up to 3 days, so plan on that build and its iOS store listing being live from Wed Oct 22.
Google Play listing graphics are not tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review.
Nov 6 submission: post-Halloween clean-up (icon and screenshots back to normal).

{"presentationId": "f_5ebf55ad29e815d46243c8", "title": "Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025", "revisionId": "09590bf741", "slideCount": 4, "text": "Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025
Halloween and the holidays, store and ads

Seasonal dressing goes on top of the current art only. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the zombie swap with the new background, Jul 29) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture is the one that counts.
A video whose master has the music baked in is re-cut first from a master without music (re-export one from the project if there is none), so the seasonal pass can be edited.
Before any seasonal pass

Only the seasonal layer changes: pumpkins, fog, props, the title treatment. Same flat background, same pose, same zombie order, same CTA, so a seasonal variant still tests clean against its normal version.
What changes

Calls for the tracker

Skip: no seasonal version this time."}

input.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — Art Plan
input.bodyText:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — Art Plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art Lead). For review Thu Oct 2. Comment anywhere.
Tracker (every item, call, owner, due date): see "ZM3D Halloween 2025 — Tracker" in the same share.

1. Goal
Leonard's ask (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30): everything players see from us looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October, meaning the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live today: 4 store surfaces and 57 Unity creatives. That's the 56 on the live creatives sheet plus Julia's 4:5 static (ART-826). It still runs on iOS UK and Frederick flagged it on the roadmap card, but it isn't on the sheet.

2. Key dates (all PT)
- Wed Oct 15: every Halloween ad is with Frederick. Unity has to approve creatives before a flight starts (Frederick's Sep 30 update moved this from Oct 17).
- Thu Oct 16, 12:00: merge cut for the Oct 17 build. The Halloween icon and the new iOS screenshots (iPhone 6.5" + iPad 12.9") have to be in by then. iOS screenshots can only change with a new version.
- Fri Oct 17: store submission. Plan on Apple review taking up to 3 days.
- Sat Oct 18 – Fri Oct 31: Halloween flight on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone.
- Wed Oct 22: the iOS build, Halloween icon and iOS screenshots go live.
- Sun Oct 12: the Android US tablet campaign ends and its budget moves to iOS UK. Nothing that runs only there gets a Halloween version.
- Google Play listing graphics aren't tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review.
- Nov 6 submission: icon and screenshots go back to normal.

3. Rules we're applying (Robert's "Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025")
- The seasonal layer goes on top of current art only. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) gets redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture counts.
- A video whose master has the music baked in gets re-cut first from a master without music.
- Only the seasonal layer changes: pumpkins, fog, props, the title treatment. Same flat background, pose, zombie order and CTA, so each Halloween version still tests clean against its normal one.
- Calls: Halloween version = dress it from the current art. Refresh first = re-capture, re-render or re-cut, then add Halloween. Reuse = a seasonal version already exists, use it. Skip = no seasonal version this time.

4. Store
- iPhone 6.5" set: REUSE. Martin exported the Halloween set (5 screens) to ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store on Sep 30. Same comps as the live Sep 17 set. It goes up with the Oct 17 submission, so it must be in by the Oct 16 12:00 cut. No ticket, per Leonard.
- Google Play phone set: REUSE. Martin's Halloween export (6 screens) is in the same folder. Upload by Fri Oct 17 so it's live by Sat Oct 18, when the flight starts. No ticket.
- iPad 12.9" set: HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. No Halloween iPad set exists yet. Martin, due Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT (in for the Oct 17 submission). New ART ticket.
- App icon: HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. Martin. On the "swap around the 24th" idea: on iOS the icon ships inside the build, so it can't move on its own date. It has to be merged by Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT and goes live with the build around Wed Oct 22. Proposal: Martin hands it to engineering by Tue Oct 14 so the merge isn't a scramble. Google Play's listing icon can go up the same week. New ART ticket.

5. Ads (Unity): summary
- 14 Halloween version (Marcus): ART-808, 809, 816, 817, 818, 819, 833, 834, 835, 848, 851, 852, 853, 854. Sources are the Aug–Sep captures and renders (#1529 and later). ART-809 uses Marcus's no-music master from Aug 13.
- 33 Refresh first: 27 Marcus (videos and end cards), 6 Martin (Julia stills ART-825, 826, 827, 828, 829, 830). All come from pre-#1452 builds (Apr–Jul captures, Jun stills, Dec 2024 prototype footage). Several also have music baked in (796, 798, 799, 802, 807, 847) and need a master without music.
- 10 Skip: ART-806, 811, 813, 820, 821, 822, 824, 842, 844, 849. They'll only be running on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12. That includes squirrelfail landscape and mrfluffernot landscape, which Frederick took off iOS UK tablet on Sep 29.
- 0 Reuse. Marcus's cheer fastcouch Halloween test (9:16 + 16:9 in UA masters) was built on the July capture. Robert rejected it on Sep 30, and Marcus is redoing both from the Sep 16 capture (ART-808, ART-816).

6. Due dates
- Halloween version: Halloween file to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Refresh first: proposed checkpoint Fri Oct 10 for the refreshed capture, render or master. Halloween file to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Every ad ticket has a comment with its call and due date. Tickets needing new work are assigned to the maker so Frederick can queue uploads.

7. Risks and asks for Thursday
- Marcus's load: 41 deliverables (27 refresh + 14 Halloween) by Oct 15. Many are aspect-ratio siblings of one capture (couch alpha, balloons, barrel, cheer, boris, tutorial), so one re-capture covers several. It's still the critical path. Ask: confirm capacity or agree on a priority order. Suggested order: best-performing 9:16s on iOS UK phone first, then 16:9 for iOS UK tablet.
- boris fastcouch (ART-840): the gameplay is the Jul 28 capture. The Sep 16 fastcouch re-capture (#1896) may cover it with the Boris opening re-attached. Marcus to confirm.
- ART-826 (Julia 4:5 static) should go on the live creatives sheet. Frederick to add it.
- Who uploads the store sets (iOS with the submission, Google Play by Oct 17)? Arthur/Leonard to confirm.
- Post-Halloween: the icon and screenshots revert with the Nov 6 submission. The ads come off when the flight ends Oct 31.

Sources: live creatives sheet (Frederick), ART ticket comments, ZM3D release calendar Q4 (Arthur), Seasonal art direction Q4 2025 (Robert), Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12) and changes (Sep 30), Unity retention restart email (Sep 29), roadmap card "Halloween push", #zombie-art threads (Sep 29–30).

Halloween plan + tracker are ready for Thursday :jack_o_lantern: Shared with everyone on the review invite, all of you can comment.
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/b2eb64ec2f2794281e066bd7/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lvjazldonnD4ztYoidVIFC7xFnvHYL7FXHlEgX0cVgk/edit

*Short version*
• *Store:* reuse Martin's Halloween iPhone 6.5" and Google Play sets (already exported). New art for the iPad 12.9" set (ART-856) and the icon (ART-855), both Martin, due Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT for the Oct 17 build.
• *Icon timing:* the 24th doesn't work on iOS because the icon ships inside the build. It has to merge by the Oct 16 cut and goes live with the build around Oct 22.
• *Ads (57, including Julia's 4:5 "They're coming, stop them!", ART-826):*
  ◦ 14 Halloween version (Marcus)
  ◦ 33 Refresh first: 27 Marcus, 6 Julia stills Martin. They're from captures older than the Jul 29 swap, and some have music baked in.
  ◦ 10 Skip: they'll only be running on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12.
  ◦ 0 reuse: the cheer fastcouch test was built on the July capture.
• *Dates:* every Halloween ad goes to Frederick by Wed Oct 15 for the Oct 18–31 flight. Proposed refresh checkpoint is Fri Oct 10.
• Every ad's ART ticket has its call and due date in a comment. The 47 that need work are assigned to Marcus or Martin, so @Frederick can queue the uploads from Linear.
• *To discuss Thursday:* Marcus has 41 deliverables by Oct 15. Lots are aspect-ratio siblings of the same capture, but we should agree a priority order.
